name: moneyball
description: Measure what every subagent run cost and whether it worked, then route each job to the cheapest model that does it.
tagline: Pay for the model each job needs: measure every subagent run, graduate repeat work to cheaper models on evidence.

platformNotes.copilot: reads VS Code Copilot Chat and Copilot CLI sessions (storage verified; message details unverified); routing applies where the subagent tool takes a model argument
platformNotes.cursor: reads your Cursor history (verified on real data); Cursor records no tokens, so runs are judged on outcomes and savings show as unknown; advice only (a hook cannot set a Cursor subagent's model)
platformNotes.codex: reads Codex rollouts with token usage (format checked against the Codex source, not yet seen on a real install); routing needs a subagent tool with a model argument
platformNotes.gemini: reads Gemini CLI chats with token usage (format checked against the Gemini CLI source, not yet seen on a real install); no subagent model routing
platformNotes.windsurf: CLI reports only; no Windsurf transcript reader yet
